# SECOND SUN — Credits and asset log

**Everything seen and heard in this film is generated by the code in `source/`.**
No photographs, footage, textures, 3D models, samples, soundfonts, loops or AI-generated media were used.

## External assets

| Asset | Where used | License | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Cormorant Garamond** (Regular, Medium, Italic, Medium Italic), © 2015 The Cormorant Project Authors | On-screen text cards and title | SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`shared/fonts/OFL.txt`) | fonts.google.com / fonts.gstatic.com |

That is the complete list. Nothing else external appears in the picture or the soundtrack.

## Software (tools, not assets)

Python 3.11, NumPy, SciPy, skia-python (Skia), OpenCV, pyloudnorm, FFmpeg/libx264, and Blender 4.0 (used only in the pipeline bake-off; nothing from it is in the film).

## Made in code

- **Picture:** procedural environments (`world.py`, `shotkit.py`), 2D-rigged creatures with IK and distance-locked gaits (`rig.py`, `creatures.py`), 31 shot programs (`shots_*.py`), and a post-process stack (`frame.py` plus `shared/foxfolly/post.py`).
- **Score:** additive, physically inspired synthesis (`instruments.py`): felt piano with inharmonic partials and a hammer transient, Karplus-Strong harp and pizzicato, bowed strings with body resonances and vibrato, a formant choir, brass, celesta, and the glass "Star" tone. It is composed as note events in `music.py` and placed in a synthetic convolution hall.
- **Sound design:** every effect is synthesised in `sfx.py`: wind, water, frogs, crickets, insects, dragonfly wings, footfalls scaled to mass (timed from the same gait functions that plant the feet), feathers, chirps, Old Horn's closed-mouth hum, the rex's infrasonic boom, bellows, the seismic rumble, the surge, bead whistles and hisses, fire, ash, the brush on stone, and museum room tone.

**Studio:** Fox & Folly. The script is by the channel; direction, design, animation, music, sound and editing are by Claude (code).
